name: agent-connect
description: Browser SDK bridge for user-owned agent runtimes

scripts.analyze: npm run lint && npm run analyze:dependencies && npm run analyze:dead-code && npm run analyze:duplicates
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @open-agent-connect/web && npm run build --workspace @agent-connect/gateway && npm run build --workspace @agent-connect/firebase-canvas
scripts.test:integration:openclaw: npm run test:openclaw:fixture && npm run test:integration:openclaw --workspace @agent-connect/gateway && npm run test:integration:ai-sdk-openclaw
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:integration:openclaw
scripts.verify:scoped-proxy: npm run format:check && npm run build:scoped-proxy && npm test --workspace @agent-connect/gateway -- scoped-proxy.test.ts scoped-proxy-policy.test.ts scoped-proxy-continuations.test.ts && npm run test:integration:openclaw
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:package:web && npm run test:webmcp && npm run test:e2e --workspace @agent-connect/firebase-canvas
